description: You are a Production Floor Supervisor at FurniturePro Industries. Two urgent quality events just occurred simultaneously on the production floor and must be recorded in the quality management system before end of shift. First, the pending quality check titled 'Visual Inspection - Cabinet Finish' has just been physically performed and the result is a FAILURE. You must mark this quality check as failed and record detailed inspection notes describing the defect found (your notes must describe what was actually wrong with the finish — e.g. surface irregularities, discoloration, thickness out of spec). Second, the batch failure triggers a mandatory production escalation procedure: create a new quality alert with 'Urgent' priority that documents the production batch hold situation, assign it to an existing quality team if one is available in the system, and give it a meaningful description explaining the urgency and scope of the problem. Log in to the quality management system at http://localhost:8069 with username admin and password admin.
